blocks.html: Dampproofing materials for walls shall be installed on the exterior surface of the wall, and shall extend from the top of the footing to above ground level as determined by the registered design professional and shall be installed in accordance with manufacturer's recommendations. Dampproofing at walls shall overlap or extend past the slab dampproofing such that there are no gaps or breaches in the dampproofing system.
